title: A finished merge trial whose completion was lost leaves flight within one cycle
description: The merge writer over detached trial runs whose completions never reach the loop: once a run writes its exit and result files, the next cycle settles the head on that verdict, master status stops showing it in flight, and its lane takes the next candidate. A trial still running beside it is untouched, and no loop restart is needed.

steps.name: a finished trial is collected from its files without a restart
